name: Heartspell: Horizon Academy
source:
You're the newest student at the Horizon Wizarding Academy, an eclectic institution deep in the spirit realms. There you'll learn magic, meet fellow students, and uncover secrets that threaten the very foundation of the academy. Scholomatch is a game about dating sirens, werewolves, fairies, and a host of other wizarding students. Solve puzzles and build relationships as you explore the stories of deep, nuanced characters populating a rich world brimming with fantasy, wonder, and just a little spice.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2113350/Scholomatch/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你是地平线巫师学院的最新学生，这是一个深入精神领域的不拘一格的机构。在那里你将学习魔法，结识同学，并揭开威胁学院基础的秘密。Scholomatch是一款关于与海妖、狼人、仙女和许多其他魔法学生约会的游戏。当你探索充满幻想、奇迹和一点点趣味的丰富世界中的深刻而细致的角色的故事时，解决谜题并建立关系。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2113350/Scholomatch/]Steam[/url]]
